description: This file defines REST API routes for user authentication, including signup and login functionality, using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It manages creating new users with hashed passwords, validating user credentials, and issuing JWT tokens.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User database model representing user accounts, including fields such as name, email, phone, and password hash.

methods.name: AuthResponse signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, hash their password, store user info in the database, and return a JWT token.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to verify user credentials and issue a JWT token upon successful authentication.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/
